features.summary: Tenant isolation · RBAC (users / roles / menus / departments / dictionaries) · five data-scope levels · operation and login logs · force logout of online users · JWT + Redis blacklist · rate limiting / duplicate-submit guard / end-to-end TraceId · Redis monitoring

newModule.desc: Backend: create a package under <c>backend/gentry-business/src/main/java/com/gentry/</c>, following the controller/service/mapper/entity/dto/vo layering of <c>rbac/dept</c>. Frontend: add a page under <c>src/pages/</c> and register it in <c>utils/menuMapper.ts</c>. Permissions: add a Flyway migration inserting <c>sys_menu</c> + <c>sys_role_menu</c> rows. See <c>doc/guide/RBAC模块开发指南.md</c> for details.
